description: Start live screen mirroring for a device using scrcpy. Requires scrcpy installed and on PATH. Supports windowed (visual) and headless (no display) modes. One session per device.

bitrate.description: Video bitrate (e.g., '4M', '8M', '2M'). AK2 fix: format-validated at schema layer.

headless.description: No-display mode — useful with recording. Omits the scrcpy window.

maxSize.description: Max dimension in pixels (0 = no limit, max 4096)

record.description: Record to a local file path (e.g., 'mirror.mp4')

turnScreenOff.description: Turn device screen off during mirroring (saves battery)

name: adb_mirror_start
